transcript.text: Hello, this is the Legal Coordination Assistant for Smallest AI. I can help you with NDAs, MSAs, or vendor registration. How can I assist you today?
Hi, this is urgent. We've been waiting 3 weeks for NDA counter-signature from your side. The deal is stalled.
I understand this is urgent, and I apologize for the delay. To check the status of that NDA, could you please provide the name of your company?
